description: The nightly's full run names its container as a flow map, `{ image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright, options: --user 1001 }`, with no tag — Docker's `latest`. The name ends at the comma. A pattern that let the repository end only at a quote or a space did not see this mention at all, and a mention it does not see carries no version to refuse.

workflows..github/workflows/nightly.yml:
jobs:
  full:
    container: { image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright, options: --user 1001 }
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx run-many -t e2e
  flake:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
  mutation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
